history.summary: 99yr leasehold 4BR EC-style 1,216sqft unit at iNz Residence, D23 Choa Chu Kang/Bukit Panjang, at $1.8M / $1,480 PSF. Reasonable absolute price for a 4BR family unit in a 2019 development, but no URA data, an LRT-only location 950m away, and OCR-fringe positioning cap the investment case.
history.rating_rationale: $1.48M-ish... actually $1.8M for a 4BR at $1,480 PSF is a sensible family entry, and the arena record (219-197-2, Elo 1209, score 568) is the better half of the batch. But there is zero URA appreciation/transaction/median data to verify value, connectivity is LRT-only (BP2 South View, 950m) feeding into Bukit Panjang, and D23 OCR appreciation tends to track the ~3.7% baseline. Solid family home, average investment — Neutral.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/txn/median data to verify value
LRT-only access 950m away — weak rail connectivity
D23 OCR location with no specific catalyst in the dossier; 99yr leasehold
catalysts: Affordable 4BR family unit at $1.8M with deep HDB-upgrader demand in CCK/Bukit Panjang
Relatively young (2019) leasehold; better-than-batch arena record
